summary: Independently re-derived, re-constructed, and adversarially re-tested both governance/verification.py repairs made in Chapter 146H -- 146H.1 (schema-version support, derived from the manifest instead of a hardcoded duplicate constant) and 146H.3 (confirmation_binding/provenance_consistency/integrity_consistency retargeted at the real CHGR-REQ-201 relationship after the obsolete _confirmable_content_digest_of helper was removed) -- without trusting either repair report's own claims. Read verification.py, publication/record.py (build_publication_record, compute_record_digest), publication/coordinator.py (PublicationCoordinator.execute), publication_service.py, the CLI's governance_record.py, the CHGR manifest, and all four records/*.schema.json files directly. Constructed a fresh four-artifact CHGR bundle using the real, unmodified build_publication_record production function (not a fixture, not reused evidence) and verified it successfully end-to-end through both the internal verify_artifact_at_path API and the real `pcae governance-record verify --related x3` CLI, with confirmation_binding, provenance_consistency, and integrity_consistency all reporting passed, not skipped -- the exact outcome Phase 146H demonstrated was previously and unconditionally impossible. Ran an adversarial matrix of over twenty scenarios across schema-version (stale/future/malformed/family-mismatch), confirmation-binding (mismatched confirmed_content_digest/preview_rendering_digest, malformed digest, reconstructed obsolete formula), provenance (mismatched preview_content_digest, wrong-type/foreign-bundle substitution), integrity (mismatched payload_digest, tampered primary record), and bundle composition (reordered --related args, malformed related bytes, duplicate siblings) -- every case failed closed as required, with two exceptions raised as findings below. Independently re-recomputed the manifest's human_confirmation_evidence.schema.json file_digest and confirmed it matches; confirmed only the confirmed_content_digest field description changed, no validation semantics. Independently diff-reviewed the three migrated test fixtures against a freshly-constructed real bundle, confirming self-consistency with production output, not merely internal self-consistency. Full evidence in docs/PHASE_146H3V_GOVERNANCE_VERIFICATION_REPAIRS_INDEPENDENT_VERIFICATION.md. Verdict: VERIFIED WITH NON-BLOCKING FINDINGS. No Blocking finding. Recommends 146I -- CHGR-001 Schema-Envelope Operational Readiness Assessment (not an authorization).
tests_added_or_updated: No test files added or modified by this phase (independent-verification-only scope; no repair authorized). All adversarial reproduction was performed live, in-process and via scratch files outside the tracked repository tree, deleted at phase close.
